source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 131 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text: SEC. 51P-131.101.LEGISLATIVE HISTORY. PD 131 was established by Ordinance No. 17213, passed by the Dallas City Council on November 18, 1981. Ordinance No. 17213 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. Ordinance No. 17213 was amended by Ordinance No. 18688, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 8, 1985. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 17213; 18688; 25508)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text: SEC. 51P-131.102.PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE. PD 131 is established on property generally located along Fitzhugh Avenue, between Abbott Avenue and the M.K.&T. Railroad. The size of PD 131 is approximately 1.12 acres. (Ord. Nos. 18688; 25508)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-131.103.DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.
(a)Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.
(b)Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25508)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text: SEC. 51P-131.104.DEVELOPMENT PLAN. All development must be in accordance with the city plan commission-approved development plan that is labelled Exhibit 131A. (Ord. Nos. 18688; 25508)

sections.title: Subdivision Plat
sections.text: SEC. 51P-131.105.SUBDIVISION PLAT. Prior to the issuance of any building permit, a subdivision plat approved by the city plan commission must be filed for record with the county clerk. (Ord. Nos. 18688; 25508)

sections.title: Uses
sections.text: SEC. 51P-131.106.USES. The only permitted use on the Property is single-family, which may consist of attached or detached dwelling units. (Ord. Nos. 18688; 25508)

sections.title: Density
sections.text: SEC. 51P-131.107.DENSITY. A maximum of nine dwelling units are permitted. (Ord. Nos. 18688; 25508)

sections.title: Height
sections.text: SEC. 51P-131.108.HEIGHT. No structure may exceed 30 feet in height. No structure may contain more than two occupied floors. (Ord. Nos. 18688; 25508)

sections.title: Coverage
sections.text: SEC. 51P-131.109.COVERAGE. Maximum permitted coverage on each lot, including the main building and all accessory buildings, may not exceed 60 percent. (Ord. Nos. 18688; 25508)

sections.title: Setbacks
sections.text: SEC. 51P-131.110.SETBACKS. Minimum rear yard setback is 10 feet. (Ord. Nos. 18688; 25508)

sections.title: Parking
sections.text: SEC. 51P-131.111.PARKING. Parking must be provided at the ratio of two spaces for each residential unit. (Ord. Nos. 18688; 25508)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text: SEC. 51P-131.112.SIGNS. All signs must comply with the sign provisions for non-business zoning districts as specified in the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 18688; 25508)

sections.title: Landscaping
sections.text: SEC. 51P-131.113.LANDSCAPING. Landscaping must be provided as shown on the approved development plan and must be maintained in a healthy, growing condition at all times. (Ord. Nos. 18688; 25508)

sections.title: Screening
sections.text: SEC. 51P-131.114.SCREENING. Screening in accordance with the Dallas Development Code must be provided along the north and west boundary lines of the Property. (Ord. Nos. 18688; 25508)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text: SEC. 51P-131.115.PAVING. All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 18688; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text: SEC. 51P-131.116.COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS. The building official shall not issue a building permit or a certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there is full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 18688; 25508; 26102)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text: SEC. 51P-131.117.ZONING MAP. PD 131 is located on Zoning Map No. I-7. (Ord. Nos. 18688; 25508)
